product_metadata.title: IRIS USA 33 Qt Plastic Under Bed Storage Bin with Lids and Durable Buckles, 3 Pack, Multi-Purpose Container Box for Clothes, Shoes, and Duvets, Clear
features: EVERYDAY ORGANIZATION: Clear containers are large enough for organizing all of your home and storage needs. Perfect for keeping dirt and dust away from clothes, shoes, and bed linens. Also great for storing away seasonal or holiday items.

SPACE SAVING: These bins are great for fitting in tight spaces and maximizing your storage capabilities. The tight fitting durable lids can also stack securely for efficient use of space, transport and more.
CLEAR VIEW: Quickly and easily find all your items with the clear view drawer. Organize your closet easily and conveniently with these heavy-duty boxes.

UNIQUE DESIGN: Sleek and narrow design is perfect for sliding under tight spaces anywhere in the bedroom, under beds, kid's room, or bathroom. Also great for garage, school, or office use. Secure lids will ensure that all your items remain dry and dust-free.

FLOOR PROTECTION: The bottom of container features casters to slip, pull, and cart away the storage containers without damaging delicate floors. They easily slip over carpet and rugs for added efficiency.
description: Don’t let unused space go to waste! Utilize every inch with the Store-N-Slide under-bed storage series. Multi-use containers keep out-of-season clothes, linens and even wrapping paper in an easy-to-reach place for quick access. Low-friction gliders on the bottom help totes slide in and out with ease. Containers also nest into each other for a unique stacking option to help maximize the usage of space.
